The March Around Jericho

Take the city without a single blade drawn.

  • Beat the drum by tapping A and D in alternation (or tap the two pads on screen). Beat steadily to keep marching — beat faster to move faster.
  • Drag the screen with your mouse or finger to look around as you walk the circuit.
  • Complete the circuit seven times. On the seventh lap, the trumpets will sound.
  • Then — when the moment comes — SHOUT, and watch what happens to the wall.

One house is still standing on the eastern wall — a scarlet cord hangs from its window. Whatever comes down, that house does not.

The Wall Has Fallen

Seven laps, one shout, and the ring of Jericho lies flat around the city — all but one house.

Rahab's house still stands on the eastern wall, the scarlet cord still hanging from its window.
